title: Reef Rescue
storyOpening: Far below the ocean waves, a young reef shark named Finn noticed that the coral garden had gone quiet. Silver fish that usually darted between the rocks were nowhere to be seen.
missionPrompt: Help Finn search the reef, read the clues near the coral cave, and count the missing fish so the reef feels alive again!
readingPassage: Blue light shimmered across the coral reef as Finn the young shark searched for his fish friends. He swam past waving sea plants and noticed tiny bubbles rising from a dark cave. Finn uses gills to breathe underwater, just like other fish. His guide pointed to the slits along his neck — gills that pull oxygen from the water with every swim. With a flick of his fin, Finn spotted silver fish hiding below. If Finn follows the bubbles, he might find the missing fish.
storyEnding: The reef hums with life again. Finn swims in happy circles while his fish friends reappear from the cave — thanks to you, the reef mystery is solved!
reflectionPrompt: Which clue helped you the most near the coral cave?
creativePrompt: Design a secret underwater hideout for Finn. What would be inside?

questions.mysterySetup: Finn notices the coral garden has gone quiet. Why might the silver fish be hiding?
clues: Tiny bubbles keep rising from a dark cave nearby.

questions.prompt: What best explains why the fish disappeared from the open reef?
choices: They are hiding in the cave for safety

They are resting on the sandy seafloor nearby
questions.correctAnswer: They are hiding in the cave for safety
questions.explanation: Bubbles from the cave, fish darting from that spot, and a silver flicker inside all support that the fish are hiding in the cave.
